description: Summarize and visualize the reported GNAL (DYT25) pathogenic variant spectrum by type
code:
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

# Curated reported GNAL pathogenic/likely-pathogenic variants from primary literature
variants = [
    ("p.Ser293*",      "nonsense",   "Fuchs 2013 (23222958)"),
    ("p.Val137Met",    "missense",   "Fuchs 2013 (23222958)"),
    ("p.Val228Phe",    "missense",   "Vemula 2013 (23449625)"),
    ("p.Arg198Thrfs*13","frameshift", "Vemula 2013 (23449625)"),
    ("p.Arg245*",      "nonsense",   "Vemula 2013 (23449625)"),
    ("p.Met1?",        "start-loss", "Vemula 2013 (23449625)"),
    ("p.Asp210Asn",    "missense",   "Carecchio 2016 (26725140)"),
    ("p.Val354Ala",    "missense",   "Dobricic 2014 (24729450) de novo"),
    ("p.Ser95*",       "nonsense",   "Miao 2013 (23759320)"),
    ("c.932-7T>G",     "splice",     "Miao 2013 (23759320)"),
]
df = pd.DataFrame(variants, columns=["variant","type","source"])
counts = df["type"].value_counts()
print("GNAL variant class distribution (representative literature set):")
print(counts.to_string())
print("\nTruncating (nonsense+frameshift+start-loss+splice):",
      sum(counts.get(t,0) for t in ["nonsense","frameshift","start-loss","splice"]),
      "| missense:", counts.get("missense",0))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7,4))
colors = {"missense":"#4C72B0","nonsense":"#C44E52","frameshift":"#DD8452",
          "start-loss":"#8172B3","splice":"#937860"}
counts.plot(kind="bar", ax=ax, color=[colors[t] for t in counts.index])
ax.set_ylabel("Number of reported variants")
ax.set_title("DYT25 / GNAL pathogenic variant spectrum (representative set)")
ax.set_xlabel("Variant class")
plt.xticks(rotation=20, ha="right")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("gnal_variant_spectrum.png", dpi=120)
print("\nInterpretation: Mix of truncating (LOF) and missense variants is consistent with")
print("haploinsufficiency as the disease mechanism for DYT25.")
